why_selected: High line vs deep block (WC 2022): Netherlands defend high, Qatar sit deep.

coordinate_frames.location: StatsBomb 120x80 pitch, in the acting/defending team's OWN frame: own goal at x=0, opponent goal at x=120 (so larger x = defending further up the pitch).
